overview: 1943 List of Papers (items 117-157) indexes diplomatic and FCC/FBIS/OWI/Navy monitoring of Japanese broadcasts: Radio Tokyo commentators, economic intelligence, domestic and marine propaganda, Manchuria and Philippines coverage, Netherlands Indies broadcasts, and Japan-Argentina radio traffic.

subfiles.title: List of Papers for Wireless Telephone/Radio—Japan, items 117–157
subfiles.about: A departmental register summarizes correspondence, telegrams, reports, and enclosures concerning Japanese radio broadcasts, propaganda, and intercepted communications.
subfiles.summary: Index covers monitored Japanese broadcasts from Moscow, Kuibyshev, and Shanghai; Radio Tokyo's Jack Holland; an FCC commentator study; risks of reusing Japanese material; Makassar transmissions; Domei and Japan-Argentina intercepts; Philippine constitution broadcasts; and expanded domestic/marine monitoring.

interest: Shows WWII interagency monitoring of Japanese radio broadcasts, from Radio Tokyo personnel to Japan-Argentina traffic.
